user.title: Discover EVSE chargers
user.description:
**Press Submit to start an automatic search** (~10 seconds on UDP port **28376**).

**Before you press Submit:**
- Close the **EVSEMaster** mobile app (it conflicts with this integration)
- Charger and Home Assistant must be on the **same LAN / VLAN**
- **Docker:** Home Assistant needs a real LAN presence — `network_mode: host` **or** a LAN IP via macvlan/ipvlan (e.g. `home-lan` + `ipv4_address`). Bridge / mapping only port 28376 is usually not enough

If nothing is found, you can enter the serial manually on the next screen.

select.title: Select your EVSE
select.description: {count} charger(s) found on the network. Select one and enter the password from the EVSEMaster app (factory default on many chargers: **123456**).

manual.title: Manual configuration
manual.description:
No new charger found automatically (or manual entry chosen).

Enter the serial number and password from the EVSEMaster app (often **123456** by default). Enable **Search again** to retry discovery.

If discovery stays empty: same LAN, app closed, UDP 28376 open, and for Docker use host networking or a LAN IP (macvlan).

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the charger. Check power, same LAN, UDP 28376, and Docker host networking / LAN IP if applicable.
